entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jaya Harivarman I, known as his formal name Sivänandana, was a Phan Rang noble and King of Champa. Rising to power during the 12th Century Khmer–Cham wars, he spent much of his rule consolidating his control over Champa. He was succeeded by his son, Jaya Harivarman II.
